how_to_apply: The mode is a walk-in interview at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004. Candidates report between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM on the date for their post: 2 December 2026 for Head & Neck Surgery and Surgical Oncology, 3 December 2026 for Anaesthesiology, and 4 December 2026 for Onco-Pathology. The phone number printed in the notice is 9472377509.
Send an intimation mail to [email protected] prior to reporting.
Mention the advertisement number and the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Report on your post's interview date with the Bio-Data, a recent passport size photograph, a copy of PAN card, Aadhar Card, original certificates and sets of attested copies of all certificates.

Outstation candidates may attend the online interview. They must email a request for an online interview, with their resume and supporting documents in a single PDF file, to [email protected] by 30.11.2026, 3:00 p.m.
The date of the written test and/or interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email, and all correspondence is done through the same email id.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, is the body inviting applications. The posts are for its Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre at the Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar). The notice is signed by the Administrative Officer III (HRD), HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur.

content_sections.text: The notice lists 9 Senior Resident posts in four departments. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/- (Rupees One-Lakh Thirty Three Thousand Six Hundred Twenty Three Only) for a Senior Resident. Tenure: tenure-based positions for a fixed period up to one year, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. Security deposit: the selected Senior Resident has to deposit Rs. 1,33,623/-, refundable after successful completion of tenure. Accommodation: provided on a sharing basis, subject to availability. Joining: the selected candidate has to join immediately, subject to being found medically fit.

The phone number printed in the notice is 9472377509. The date of the written test and/or interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email, and all correspondence is done through the same email id.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates report with the following original documents: Bio-Data 10th passing certificate MBBS Degree D.M/M.D/M.S./D.N.B or Equivalent degree Attempt Certificate of Post Graduate/Post-Doctoral degree First page of research publication (PubMed Indexed/Non-Indexed) Oral/Poster Presentation Certificate Proof of receiving Award/Gold medal, if any Experience Certificates after Post Graduate/Post-Doctoral degree Copy of Aadhar card and PAN Card

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident posts are there in HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur?
faq.answer: There are 9 posts: 4 in Head & Neck Surgery, 2 in Surgical Oncology, 2 in Anaesthesiology and 1 in Onco-Pathology. The notice says Tata Memorial Centre may increase or decrease the number.

faq.question: Q2. When are the walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: Head & Neck Surgery and Surgical Oncology are on 2 December 2026, Anaesthesiology on 3 December 2026 and Onco-Pathology on 4 December 2026, between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident at HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur?
faq.answer: Each post needs a postgraduate degree in its field, such as M.D./D.N.B. (Anaesthesiology) or M.D./D.N.B. (Pathology), recognized by the National Medical Commission. Head & Neck Surgery also accepts M.D.S. (Maxillofacial Surgery) recognized by the Dental Council of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years, counted as on the date of the walk-in interview. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Resident here?
faq.answer: A Senior Resident is offered a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are tenure-based for a fixed period up to one year, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a security deposit?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected Senior Resident has to deposit Rs. 1,33,623/-, which is refunded after successful completion of the tenure.
